pictures.name: OF1-He-Prays-Apart
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. Dawn on a rocky hillside in Galilee among olive trees. In the middle distance, a man in a plain cream robe with a dark brown outer cloak, shoulder-length dark hair, seen only from behind, his face never visible, kneels alone on a flat rock, hands open, facing the sunrise over the hills. In the foreground, three of his friends, bearded fishermen in faded blue and brown tunics, sit on the grass watching him quietly, one leaning forward as if about to ask something. Soft gold sunrise, deep blue shadows. Stillness, longing, wonder. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: OF2-Teach-Us
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The same olive grove in morning light. a man in a plain cream robe with a dark brown outer cloak, shoulder-length dark hair, seen only from behind, his face never visible, sits on a low stone, facing a small circle of friends, bearded fishermen and a couple of women in simple headscarves, seated on the grass and listening closely. One hand of his is lifted gently as he speaks. Their faces are warm, surprised, moved. Gold light through olive leaves, deep blue shadows. The listening circle in the middle. Close, tender, intimate. pictures.name: OF3-Midnight-Knock
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. Midnight in a first-century village lane, a sky full of stars. a tired bearded villager in a rough brown tunic, holding a small clay oil lamp, knocks on a heavy closed wooden door of a stone house with his fist, a worried, determined face. Behind him, in a doorway down the lane, a dusty traveler waits. Only his lamp lights the scene, warm gold against deep blue night. The man and the door in the middle. Urgent, hopeful, a little funny. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: OF4-The-Door-Opens
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The same village lane at midnight. The heavy wooden door is half open; a sleepy man in a nightshirt with tousled hair, holding a lamp, hands three round loaves of bread to a tired bearded villager in a rough brown tunic, holding a small clay oil lamp, who is smiling with relief. Through the doorway, a family asleep on mats. Warm gold lamplight pouring out of the open door into the deep blue night. The open door and the bread in the middle. Relief, kindness, humor. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: OF5-Bread-Not-Stone
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A small first-century courtyard at evening. A kind father with a short beard, in a brown tunic, kneels to hand his little daughter a grilled fish on a round loaf of bread; she reaches for it with both hands, delighted. A clay oven glowing behind them. Warm gold firelight, deep blue evening shadows. Father and child in the middle. Love, trust, plenty. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: OF6-Today-Mass
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The inside of a modern parish church during Mass, painted in the same sacred oil style, seen from the back pews: a full room of ordinary people of many ages and backgrounds standing, some with hands open, a few families holding hands across the aisle, all praying together toward the lit altar. Warm gold light from the altar candles, deep blue shadows along the walls and stained glass. The standing crowd in the middle. Together, quiet, one family. No text, no letters, no logos.
